change.defect: Held-out errors only checked for negativity; NaN/infinity and bool values could pass the check, while non-numeric values could raise an uncontrolled comparison error.
change.correction: Require non-boolean int/float, finite float conversion and non-negative value for each supplied held-out error.

cross_lane_decisions.A: Fail closed on invalid numeric inputs before using held-out error to evaluate a candidate.
cross_lane_decisions.F: This protects metric integrity only; it is not accepted-task quality, measured energy, lifecycle economics or a financing result.
cross_lane_decisions.H: The OpenAI 2026-10-26 theorem/complexity/QFT claims are already tracked by RG-EQN-009; do not count them as a new literature delta or as UQPU evidence.
cross_lane_decisions.C: Classical output-information, memory, transfer and reconstruction costs remain explicit.
cross_lane_decisions.E: BIO-001 and FUS-001 remain open/model-only; no material/fuel/electricity claim changes.

acceptance.missing_value_policy: None remains permitted for unmeasured held-out errors; missing values cannot imply improvement.
acceptance.evidence_boundary: Input validation and unit tests do not prove semantic equivalence, physical truth, theorem correctness, hardware advantage or economics.

next_gate: Check exact-head GitHub Actions, then pin/build public external proof artifacts under RG-EQN-009 and continue the sparse-entry/product-formula Lane A comparison.
